summary: Ship a humane, client-local daily-visit streak indicator plus a once-per-ISO-week weekly recap (card + full-screen route + past-recaps list + Settings sub-screen), all behind a single GrowthBook flag and default-on per-account toggles.
approach: Single feature directory src/features/activityAndRecap/ owns storage (tier 3 account MMKV via src/storage/index.ts:145), a pure computeNextStreak reducer with UTC monotonic guard and IANA-tz day anchor, a useStreakTracker hook that observes AppState + Home-tab focus + feed-render signal, a TanStack Query hook for weeklyRecap (capped-page getAuthorFeed + getProfile, persistedVersion 1), and a central useStreaksAndRecapEnabled flag gate mirroring src/features/quickReact/hooks/useQuickReactsEnabled.ts:12. Screens live under src/screens/Recap, src/screens/PastRecaps, src/screens/Settings/ActivityAndRecap. The streak indicator mounts into the existing right slots of HomeHeaderLayoutMobile.tsx and HomeHeaderLayout.web.tsx; the recap card is passed into NotificationFeed's ListHeaderComponent slot from src/view/screens/Notifications.tsx. Account-removal cleanup is added to removeAccount in src/state/session/index.tsx alongside the existing clearAgeAssuranceDataForDid call.

steps.description: Extend the Account schema with streak, followerSnapshots, and activityAndRecap fields. Export companion types from the feature and wire constants (max ring-buffer size 35, grace flag, 20h UTC guard, empty-copy string, retry budget 2/hr).
steps.test_strategy: compile-time; exercised via S2/S3 unit tests

steps.description: Implement the pure reducer computeNextStreak + day-math helper (IANA-tz YYYY-MM-DD anchor via Intl.DateTimeFormat en-CA). Implement ISO-week helper (YYYY-Www, Mon 00:00 through Sun 23:59:59.999 local) using date-fns. Rules per requirements.md §3.3. Zero RN dependencies.
Implement rankTopPost (sort by likeCount+repostCount+replyCount; tiebreaker newer) and followerDelta (max(0, end-start), degrade gracefully when a snapshot is missing). Both pure.

Account-scoped storage wrapper (read/write streak, ring buffer, toggles, dismissals, firstShown map) over src/storage/index.ts:145 `account`. Mirrors src/features/quickReact/storage.ts shape; defensive reads with version guard. Includes clearActivityAndRecapDataForDid for the account-removal cleanup hook.

Register feature flag StreaksAndRecapEnable = 'streaks_and_recap:enable' with owner/remove-by comment. Add central useStreaksAndRecapEnabled hook mirroring src/features/quickReact/hooks/useQuickReactsEnabled.ts:12 (hasSession && ax.features.enabled(...)). Every consumer calls it at the top and early-returns null.

Per-account preference hooks useShowStreakPreference / useShowRecapPreference built on useStorage(account, [did, 'activityAndRecap']) (src/storage/index.ts:102). Default true (AC-X1). Grace-day flag hidden at the hook boundary — exposed only to the Explainer dialog.

Implement useStreakTracker hook: subscribes to useOnAppStateChange (src/lib/appState.ts:15) + useIsFocused on HomeTab + a feed-render signal. 30-second contiguous foreground timer (single-timer, restart on re-foreground, cancel on tab/app change). On qualifying visit, call computeNextStreak and write via storage.ts. Capture follower snapshot on first qualifying visit of the day via a one-shot getProfile agent call. Gate entire effect tree on useStreaksAndRecapEnabled && useSession().hasSession && showStreak preference. Mount from the root sessioned shell. Feed-render signal: primary source is a callback shim that the Home PostFeed wires into feedFeedback.onItemSeen; fallback is 'first PostFeed mount on Home active tab'. Document the fallback in the hook.

Analytics events module: streak:indicatorShown, streak:explainerOpened, streak:optIn/optOut, recap:cardShown{has_posts,has_top_post,has_follower_delta}, recap:cardTapped, recap:cardDismissed, recap:optIn/optOut. Extend src/analytics/metrics/types.ts Events union. Payloads carry booleans only — no metric values (B12). Test asserts payload shape.

StreakIndicator component with platform split. index.tsx (native) renders a pressable flame+integer suitable for a Header.Slot. index.web.tsx renders the same atoms in the web header row. Both early-return null when useStreaksAndRecapEnabled() is false, hasSession is false, showStreak is off, currentStreak < 2, or route is not HomeTab (A4 hidden below day 2, A6, A7, G4). accessibilityLabel pluralized '{n}-day Bluesky streak' via plural(). testID='streakIndicator'. No animation/haptic/sound (G3). Tap opens StreakExplainerDialog.

StreakExplainerDialog (shared, single impl via src/components/Dialog). Shows currentStreak, longestStreak, rules text, grace-day note (only surface for graceUsedForCurrentStreak — G2). Settings link navigates via control.close(() => navigation.navigate('ActivityAndRecap')) — enforces the dialog-close callback footgun. No share CTA (A8, G5).

weeklyRecap query: createQueryKey('weeklyRecap', {did, weekIso}, {persistedVersion: 1}) with staleTime STALE.HOURS.ONE and gcTime GCTIME.INFINITY. queryFn paginates agent.app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed (limit 50, cursor, max 6 pages, short-circuit when oldest indexedAt < windowStart) + agent.app.bsky.actor.getProfile (for follower snapshot capture). Computes postsCount, followerDelta, ranked topPost candidates. Persisted cache stores only {uri, cid} for the top post. enabled guarded by hasSession && flag && showRecap && weekIso != null (AC-B11 zero-XRPC-on-off). Retry budget module caps automatic retries at 2/hr/weekIso in memory+MMKV; manual retry bypasses.

useRecapCardVisibility + useDismissRecapCard hooks. Visibility predicate: flag && hasSession && showRecap && priorWeekHadQualifyingVisit && !dismissed[weekIso] && (firstShownAt==null || now-firstShownAt<7d) && now>=Monday06:00 local (AC-B1, B5, B6, G7). Dismissal writes to account storage; firstShownAt set on first render. No push/email (B7) — grep guard is on the manual test path.

WeeklyRecapCard component: compact dismissible card with 3 metric preview lines. Zero-posts empty copy exactly 'No posts this week — that’s fine.' (B4). Tap navigates to Recap route (B3). Dedicated focusable dismiss button (a11y). opacity-only branch gated on useReducedMotion. testID='weeklyRecapCard'. Fires recap:cardShown (booleans only) on first render, recap:cardTapped / recap:cardDismissed.

Add Recap and PastRecaps to CommonNavigatorParams (Recap takes {weekId: string}, PastRecaps takes no params) and ActivityAndRecap (no params). Register paths /recap/:weekId, /recaps, /settings/activity-and-recap in src/routes.ts. Wire Stack.Screen entries in src/Navigation.tsx with requireAuth: true, mirroring ContentAndMediaSettings (src/Navigation.tsx:524).

RecapScreen (full-screen route). Renders three metric tiles (posts count, new followers, top post), using RecapMetricTile sub-component. Top post renders via the existing src/view/com/post/Post.tsx (src/view/com/post/Post.tsx:1) using {uri, cid} — leverages existing moderation filtering so tombstones are surfaced. Client-side fallback: iterate ranked candidates until a non-tombstoned post renders (B10). Manual 'Try again' button on error (B8). testID='recapScreen'.
PastRecapsScreen: lists up to 4 prior ISO weeks. Each row links to Recap({weekId}). No separate storage — each row re-uses the weeklyRecap query key (cache hit / refetch). testID='pastRecapsScreen'.

ActivityAndRecap Settings sub-screen (src/screens/Settings/ActivityAndRecap/index.tsx) matching the ContentAndMediaSettings pattern (src/screens/Settings/ContentAndMediaSettings.tsx:35). Two Toggle rows ('Show daily streak', 'Show weekly recap'), both default ON (X1). Past recaps link. <1s effect, no restart (X1). Fires streak:optIn/Out, recap:optIn/Out events. No re-prompt logic (G10). Also add a row to ContentAndMediaSettings linking to /settings/activity-and-recap, hidden via useStreaksAndRecapEnabled (G_settings).

Mount StreakIndicator into the right Header.Slot of HomeHeaderLayoutMobile.tsx (file:76) and into the desktop/tablet control row of HomeHeaderLayout.web.tsx (file:54). Visible only inside these layouts (Home tab only, enforced by placement + internal route guard).

Wire the WeeklyRecapCard into NotificationsScreen ListHeaderComponent. In src/view/screens/Notifications.tsx (file:268), replace the filter-conditional ListHeaderComponent with a composed header: WeeklyRecapCard (for filter === 'all' only, auto-hides when invisible) on top of the existing DisabledNotificationsWarning (for filter === 'mentions'). Internal visibility is enforced by the card itself; screen only provides the slot.

Mount useStreakTracker once inside the signed-in session shell (via a small <StreakTrackerMount/> in src/screens/Settings/ActivityAndRecap/index.tsx? No — must live in the persistent shell). Export a <ActivityAndRecapProvider/> from src/features/activityAndRecap/index.ts that renders null but invokes useStreakTracker, and mount it from the session shell. NOTE to executor: pick an existing session-shell mount site (grep for existing feature providers) and add it there; do not introduce a new top-level provider if the shell already chains them. If no clean site exists, mount from inside the HomeTab screen (not the header) so the tracker only runs while signed in + shell is alive.

Extend removeAccount in src/state/session/index.tsx (file:294) to call clearActivityAndRecapDataForDid({did: account.did}) alongside the existing clearAgeAssuranceDataForDid call. Keeps storage cleanup symmetrical on account removal (A10).

E2E Maestro-style flows: streak-indicator-visibility (A6, A7), streak-explainer-open-and-settings-link (A8 — covers dialog-close callback), recap-card-tap-opens-recap (B3), recap-card-dismiss-persists (B5), activity-and-recap-settings-roundtrip (X1), fresh-install-no-nux (X3).

unit: computeNextStreak: consecutive day in same tz → +1 (A2)
computeNextStreak: same-day second visit → unchanged, lastVisitAtUtcMs updated (A1)
computeNextStreak: exactly 1 day missed, grace unused → unchanged, graceUsedForCurrentStreak=true (A3)
computeNextStreak: 1 day missed, grace already used → reset to 1 (A4)
computeNextStreak: 2+ days missed → reset to 1, grace cleared (A4)
computeNextStreak: UTC delta <20h blocks increment regardless of local date (A5)
computeNextStreak: tz hop EWR→LAX same local day → no decrement, no increment (A5)
dayMath: en-CA formatter returns YYYY-MM-DD for IANA tz across DST transitions (A5)
isoWeek: priorWeekIso on Monday 05:59 local == week N-1; 06:01 local still == N-1 until window advance (B1)
isoWeek: Sunday 23:59:59 local → current week, Monday 00:00 → next (B1)
rankTopPost: sorts by likes+reposts+replies desc; tiebreaker = newer (B2)
followerDelta: missing start snapshot degrades to 0 without throwing (B4, R2)
retryBudget: 3rd auto-retry in same hour rejected; hour rollover resets; manual bypasses (B8)
storage: version mismatch triggers defensive reset (A9 defensive-read)
analytics: recap:cardShown payload contains only has_posts/has_top_post/has_follower_delta booleans, no counts (B12)
Lingui: snapshot pluralization of '{n}-day Bluesky streak' renders correctly for 1/2/5 (X5)
useStreaksAndRecapEnabled: returns false without session even when flag on (X6, A7)
integration: useStreakTracker: 30s contiguous foreground + Home focus + feed-render increments exactly once per day (A1, A2)
useStreakTracker: 29s foreground does not increment (A1)
useStreakTracker: foreground without Home active does not increment (A1, A6)
StreakIndicator: hidden when hasSession=false (A7)
StreakIndicator: hidden when showStreak preference off (A7, X1)
StreakIndicator: hidden when currentStreak < 2 (A7, G4)
StreakIndicator: flag off → returns null before any storage read (X6)
Account switch: streak reads swap to new DID storage (A10)
Account removal: clearActivityAndRecapDataForDid clears streak + snapshots + toggles + dismissals (A10)
Network spy: no XRPC request body contains 'streak', 'lastVisit', or 'currentStreak' fields (A9)
weeklyRecap query: showRecap toggle off → query never fires, zero XRPC calls (B11)
weeklyRecap query: paginates ≤6 pages, short-circuits when oldest indexedAt < windowStart (B8, R3)
weeklyRecap query: manual retry invokes queryFn even after 2/hr auto budget exhausted (B8)
weeklyRecap query: tombstoned top candidate → next-highest promoted; all tombstoned → topPost null (B10)
useRecapCardVisibility: zero-visit prior week → card hidden, query never fires (G7, B1)
useRecapCardVisibility: dismissed weekIso → hidden within same week (B5)
useRecapCardVisibility: firstShownAt + 7d → auto-hidden (B6)
Settings toggles: writing via per-account hook does not invoke agent.app.bsky.actor.putPreferences (X2) — grep guard + runtime spy
Settings toggles: effect propagates to StreakIndicator within <1s without reload (X1)
Feature flag off: StreakIndicator null, WeeklyRecapCard null, weeklyRecap query disabled, analytics quiet (X6)
Recap top-post render: Post component receives only {uri, cid} and renders moderation-filtered content (B10)
manual: B7 grep-guard: confirm no import of 'expo-notifications' from src/features/activityAndRecap/** or src/screens/Recap/** or src/screens/PastRecaps/**; confirm no push/email/widget in QA build

B9 a11y pass: VoiceOver + TalkBack read the pluralized streak label; RTL locale (ar/he) mirrors the indicator and card; dynamic-type XXL truncation; reduced-motion removes the card fade (only opacity branch remains)
X4 grep-guard: no setApplicationIconBadgeNumber / tab-bar badge / drawer badge call sites in feature code; manual observation confirms no icon/tab/drawer numeric badge
KPI instrumentation review: confirm analytics booleans flow to the dashboard pipeline before GA (B12, §9 observability); product sign-off on 'new followers this week' approximation label (R2)

risks.description: Timezone / DST silently breaking streaks (travel, spring-forward).
risks.mitigation: IANA tz day anchor via Intl.DateTimeFormat en-CA; reducer uses prev.lastVisitZone for delta math; UTC monotonic guard (>20h) blocks tz-hop increments; exhaustive unit tests in computeNextStreak.test.ts and dayMath.test.ts cover EWR→LAX, LAX→SYD, spring-forward, and fall-back.

risks.description: Follower-delta inaccuracy — atproto has no per-edge follow timestamps, so the daily snapshot ring buffer is lossy if the user skips sampling days.
risks.mitigation: max(0, end-start) clamp per B4; internal 'net change' labeling; user-visible copy 'new followers this week'; ring buffer sized ≥35 entries to cover 4 past recaps; graceful degrade when snapshots missing. Product sign-off required pre-GA.

risks.description: getAuthorFeed pagination cost for prolific posters could blow bandwidth or TanStack Query TTL.
risks.mitigation: 6-page hard cap (300 posts); short-circuit on oldest indexedAt < windowStart; staleTime 1h; auto-retry capped at 2/hr/weekIso; manual retry path for user-initiated recompute.

risks.description: AppState listener leak in useStreakTracker if effect teardown is incorrect.
risks.mitigation: Build exclusively on useOnAppStateChange (src/lib/appState.ts:15) which already handles subscription cleanup. Timer handle stored in a ref and cleared on every teardown. Unit test in useStreakTracker.test.tsx asserts listener removal on unmount.

risks.description: Feed-render signal plumbing may require non-trivial refactor of PostFeed / feedFeedback if onItemSeen isn't cleanly subscribable externally.
risks.mitigation: S7 documents a fallback to 'first mount of PostFeed on Home active tab'. Still satisfies AC-A1's ≥1 feed render requirement; coarser but shippable.

risks.description: Legacy Notifications.tsx edit surfaces the §17 debt item 1 risk.
risks.mitigation: Edit is a surgical ListHeaderComponent composition — no migration of the whole screen. Documented in ADR §Consequences and PR description.

risks.description: Tracker mount site uncertainty (S20): wrong mount point could leave tracker off or fire during logout.
risks.mitigation: Executor must grep for existing session-shell feature providers and mount alongside them. Fallback: mount inside the signed-in HomeTab. Hook short-circuits when hasSession is false so there is no wrong-state data-write risk.
